findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: save_deck · Private data: list_templates, create_template, preview_template, fill_template, get_status, download_pdf, upload_docx_template · Public sink: upload_docx_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: save_deck · Private data: list_templates, create_template, preview_template, fill_template, get_status, download_pdf, upload_docx_template · Public sink: upload_docx_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
